narration: Here's wild — 55% of Americans have under five thousand dollars saved for retirement. And it's not because they don't earn enough. It's because of how your brain is literally wired.
visual: Two person silhouettes side by side: left one bright amber labeled 'YOU TODAY', right one gray labeled 'YOU IN 30 YRS' with a red X disconnecting them. Stat card shows '55% HAVE UNDER $5K SAVED' in amber on dark background.

narration: Stanford researchers scanned people's brains while showing them their own future faces. Here's the thing — the brain activated the same region it uses to think about total strangers. Not yourself. A stranger.
visual: Brain SVG split down the middle: left half glowing amber labeled 'PRESENT — Feels real', right half gray labeled 'FUTURE — Feels like a stranger'. 'Stanford MRI confirmed it' callout card on light background.

narration: Because of this glitch, your brain unconsciously discounts your future needs by up to 40%. On a sixty-thousand-dollar salary, that's a hundred and seventy-eight thousand dollars in retirement savings you'll never prioritize.
visual: Two money stacks side by side: full amber stack labeled '$297K Should Save' vs a shorter gray stack that animates shrinking labeled '$119K Brain Says'. A red card drops in showing '$178,000 GAP on a $60K salary'.

narration: The fix is called auto-escalation, and it completely bypasses your brain's bias. You tell your 401k to bump contributions by one percent each year automatically — before your present brain can object.
visual: Animated bar chart showing 401k contribution percentage growing year by year from 3% to 9% across 7 bars, each bar taller than the last, labeled Y1 through Y7. Amber gradient bars on light background with auto-arrow.

narration: Workers who set this up end up with two hundred and seventeen thousand dollars more at retirement — same income, same job, same everything. The only difference is one automated setting running quietly in the background.
visual: Side-by-side comparison: red bar '$340K WITHOUT' vs tall amber bar '$557K WITH AUTO-ESCALATION'. A '+$217,000 difference' amber badge animates in at the bottom on dark background.

narration: Go to your HR portal today and turn on contribution auto-escalation. It takes under two minutes. That one click is worth a hundred and seventy-eight thousand dollars to your future self — go do it right now.
visual: Phone screen showing an HR portal with an 'Auto-Escalation ✓' button highlighted in amber. A pulsing '$178,000 WORTH TO YOUR FUTURE SELF' CTA badge on light background with a finger tap animation.
